Notices inside the whisper.cpp / ggml sources compiled into lib/arm64-v8a/libklipp_whisper.so
(third_party/whisper.cpp, whisper.cpp 1.9.4, commit 927cfce; built by app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt).
Besides the ggml authors' MIT license (LICENSE, AUTHORS), one compiled file carries a notice of its own:

ggml/src/ggml-cpu/ops.cpp, rope_yarn():

YaRN algorithm based on LlamaYaRNScaledRotaryEmbedding.py from https://github.com/jquesnelle/yarn
MIT licensed. Copyright (c) 2023 Jeffrey Quesnelle and Bowen Peng.
(The MIT terms are those of LICENSE in this folder, with this copyright line.)

The Arm KleidiAI files in ggml/src/ggml-cpu/kleidiai (MIT, Arm Limited) are not compiled (GGML_CPU_KLEIDIAI is off).
The llamafile sgemm code (ggml/src/ggml-cpu/llamafile/sgemm.cpp, MIT, Copyright 2024 Mozilla Foundation) is in the source
tree but not compiled: GGML_LLAMAFILE defaults to off when ggml is built as a subdirectory, and the library has no
llamafile_sgemm symbol.
